title: Coxeter Symmetry in Hypergeometric Functions and Elliptic Integral Moments
summary: We develop a hypergeometric framework for elliptic integral moments organized around Mishev's completed Saalschützian $L$-function and its $W(D_5)$ symmetry. The Bailey--Mishev very-well-poised ${}_7F_6(1)$ representation places complementary elliptic integral moments and harmonic hypergeometric sums in a common parameter space. We first give collision-based hypergeometric derivations of the three complementary-modulus moment families involving $K'^2$, $E'K'$, and $E'^2$.
